description: This file defines a React functional component for a Tic Tac Toe game, including game logic, rendering, and user interaction handling.

methods.name: checkWinner
methods.description: Determines if the current board state has a winner or a draw.

methods.name: makeAIMove
methods.description: Executes the AI's move based on simple heuristics, then checks for game end conditions.

methods.name: findBestMove
methods.description: Finds a potential winning move or blocking move for the AI.

methods.name: handleCellClick
methods.description: Handles user clicking a cell to make a move.

methods.name: handleGameEnd
methods.description: Handles game completion, updates scores and game result states.

methods.name: resetGame
methods.description: Resets the game to initial state for a new round.

methods.name: getCellClass
methods.description: Generates CSS class names for cells, including highlighting winning line.
